checks.name: restricted role manager cannot add account management to its own role
restricted account listing excludes outside administrators and multi-project targets
restricted account manager cannot reset an outside administrator password
restricted account manager cannot promote itself to administrator
scoped audit list and count exclude another project
scoped audit details deny another project by ID
legacy audit endpoint uses the same project isolation
ordinary operators have no management access; system administrator retains audit access
system administrator account options retain every current built-in role
restricted role creation and editing succeed only within the live permission ceiling
own role, built-in roles and roles assigned outside the full scope cannot be changed
restricted account creation cannot assign administrator, stronger roles or outside scopes
full target containment protects all account lifecycle endpoints, including multi-project users
allowed account create, edit, reset, soft-delete and restore preserve identity and audit history
registration queue and review are system-administrator-only; concurrent review commits once
audit scope snapshots resist forged metadata and later actor/project reassignment

unknown and system audit events stay administrator-only; history cannot be rewritten
